name: trading
description: Paper trading on simulated money only: place paper buy/sell orders, close positions, review the paper account, order history and reset - every order T2-gated with cash/position validation before the gate. There is deliberately NO broker connection: asks to connect a real/live broker are refused by design (T3 escalation).
route: paper trading: paper buy/sell, paper account, paper trade history, reset the paper account, connect a real broker (refused)
